name: Playtest and Performance Director: weekly grade
description: Draft a local weekly grade and evidence comparison for human review.
content: Use the owner-approved pack for the intended build and profile. If capture or execution is unavailable, record NOT_RUN locally. Run `node engine/lens.mjs <pack.json>`. Draft a local report with verdict, grade, supported points, coverage, interval and U lines. Record both build IDs and rubric hashes. Compare levels only for matching rubric hashes and profiles, and explain the cause of each change. Draft one local ticket candidate per measured finding with its pack and artifact IDs for human review. Only the human files or sends drafts. Work only on a working branch. Push only when the human asks and only to that branch. Never push to main. The human merges and deploys. Any feature switch you add is off by default. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).
